messages:
maria: Hey team — can someone do a quick security review of my PR that moves the auth middleware into the onprem runtime? It touches secrets handling and VPC egress. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4286 :eyes:

sam: can you drop the PR number + diff snippet? I can do an initial pass. :thumbsup:

maria: PR 4286 — main changes:
- move AUTH_TOKEN lookup from env to vault helper
- add onprem/vpc egress rule to allow k8s nodes -> KMS
- add local fallback in dev for plaintext token

(diff excerpt)
```diff
- AUTH_TOKEN=os.getenv("AUTH_TOKEN")
+ AUTH_TOKEN=vault_client.get("/secret/auth/token")
```
not sure if the fallback needs to stay.

oliver: pinging @security for a formal check. Also sec-bot flagged a possible secret in build/scripts/deploy.sh earlier — there was an echo of a token in one commit. :grimacing:

sec-bot: automated-scan: HIGH: Potential plaintext secret found in build/scripts/deploy.sh (line 42). Suggested action: remove commit, rotate token, and re-run scan.

kai: quick note — moving to the vault helper is good. but the local fallback will leave a credential in env for dev builds. Recommend gating fallback behind LOCAL_AUTH=1 and documenting it in README. Also, make sure we never log env vars anywhere. For onprem, customers must be able to configure KMS/HSM.

maria: thanks. I'll push a fix within an hour: remove the echo in deploy.sh, gate the fallback on LOCAL_AUTH=1, and add a short design note about egress + KMS. Should I re-run the scan or will CI do it on push?

sam: CI will re-run on push, but rotate before merge if that token is live. If it's a test token, still rotate to be safe.

security: prioritize KMS integration for onprem. For Dedicated we accept vault-only, but onprem needs a customer KMS/HSM option + audit logs. Also require a short design note that includes exact egress endpoints and minimal CIDRs. Put rotation TTL guidance in the note.

maria: okay. What CIDR granularity do you want? Right now it's kube nodes -> kms.googleapis.com and internal vault cluster.

security: we need explicit CIDRs per provider or private networking. For GCP include the KMS IP ranges or use private service connect. Also require token rotation TTL: 7 days for deploy script tokens.

oliver: also request a code-owner approval from eng-platform since it touches deploy scripts. @sam can you approve once deploy.sh is cleaned up?

sam: will review after fixes. :+1:

maria: pushed fix — removed echo, added LOCAL_AUTH gating, updated README, added short design note. CI retest triggered. sec-bot: any follow-ups?

sec-bot: automated-scan: OK: No plaintext secrets found. Note: Ensure KMS config is encrypted at rest and list KMS keys in the design note.

sam: LGTM from my side pending security sign-off. :shipit:

security: acknowledged — I'll do a quick pass. If the KMS note looks good and tests pass, we can merge after the rotation ticket completes. :eyes:

maria: thanks all, I'll create the rotation ticket and post the link here when it's ready.
